fusions.name: Patient Fang
fusions.desc: Strikes from range, dealing 18 damage and making the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Quick Bite
fusions.desc: A quick weapon bite that deals 6 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Turned Back
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
